title: Object design
summary: Scope a small system, name its core classes on the sheet, then handle one change request.

phases.title: Requirements
phases.goal: Introduce yourself in one line, state the problem and call show_question. Let them list actors and use cases. Ask once what is out of scope if it keeps growing.

phases.title: Classes
phases.goal: They name four to six core classes and what each owns. If one class holds everything, ask what it is responsible for, with point_at.

phases.title: Extension
phases.goal: Give the extension request. Ask what changes in their model and how many classes they would edit. Close and call end_round.
